title: Dataset of intracranial EEG, scalp EEG and beamforming sources from epilepsy patients performing a verbal working memory task
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous intracranial EEG, scalp EEG, and beamforming-reconstructed source data from 15 epilepsy patients performing a verbal working memory task. Subjects completed a modified Sternberg task with temporally separated encoding, maintenance, and recall phases. The dataset includes electrode coordinates, anatomical labels, and reconstructed virtual sensor data from key cognitive regions, enabling investigation of neural mechanisms underlying working memory through multimodal electrophysiological recordings.
methods_description: Electrophysiological recordings were obtained from epilepsy patients undergoing intracranial monitoring. Scalp EEG was recorded using the 10-20 system simultaneously with intracranial EEG from depth electrodes. Subjects performed a modified Sternberg working memory task with ~50 trials per session. LCMV beamforming was applied to EEG data to reconstruct virtual sensor activity in specific brain regions including dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, orbitofrontal cortex, posterior parietal cortex, auditory cortex, and primary visual cortex.
